title: Courier  -  The Right Goods in the Right Chest
design_overview:
Courier  -  The Right Goods in the Right Chest

**Premise and dialogue:** “Supplies don't help anyone if they stay in the wrong chest. Mark the pickup, mark the delivery, and show me a walkable route. I'll carry this first parcel free.”

**Existing:** personal Supplies/Output assignments, actual route navigation, nearby-storage servicing, capacity-limited cargo, backpressure and delivery practice. Transfer requests and civic hauling can take precedence, so do not bind a worker with conflicting assignments. Target four supplied logs from A to B; permit multiple trips according to actual courier capacity.

steps.title: 1 Accept one delivery
steps.design_check: COURIER record reserved and worker free of conflicting work.
steps.design_provisions: four-item free delivery authorization and shared Clipboard if needed.
steps.design_notes:
1 Accept one delivery

**Tutor:** “Four logs, one delivery. I'll carry this first parcel free.”

**Check:** COURIER record reserved and worker free of conflicting work.

**Provides:** four-item free delivery authorization and shared Clipboard if needed.

steps.title: 2 Choose pickup

cards.text: Open {Inventory} and right-click the Clipboard slot until a storage mode appears. Close the inventory and hold your Clipboard. Hold {ControlModifier} and scroll until it says Assign Supplies.
Point at the supplies chest and press {Use}. That selects the chest; it has not assigned it yet.
Now point at me, your Courier, and press {Use} without sneaking. Click Assign Clipboard Storage in the menu. Show me that last step.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Identify this lesson’s supplies chest and named tutor. Show selection first, then acknowledge only the stored Supplies link for this worker. Opening the menu is an intermediate checkpoint.
sequences.recovery: If you selected the wrong chest, close the menu, aim into empty air, hold {Sneak} and press {Use} with the Clipboard to clear the selection. Select the right chest and choose Assign Clipboard Storage again. If you cannot open the chest to load it, put the Clipboard away first.

steps.design_objective: In Supplies mode, select A and apply to the courier.
steps.design_check: committed source, permission and reachable access.
steps.design_provisions: source-container loan if necessary and pickup label; hold parcel until setup is valid.
steps.design_notes:

**Teach and demonstrate (spoken in order):**
1. “Open {Inventory} and right-click the Clipboard slot until a storage mode appears. Close the inventory and hold your Clipboard. Hold Control and scroll until it says Assign Supplies.”
2. “Point at the supplies chest and press {Use}. That selects the chest; it has not assigned it yet.”
3. “Now point at me, your Courier, and press {Use} without sneaking. Click Assign Clipboard Storage in the menu. Show me that last step.”

**Show / confirm:** Identify this lesson’s supplies chest and named tutor. Show selection first, then acknowledge only the stored Supplies link for this worker. Opening the menu is an intermediate checkpoint.

**If it goes wrong:** “If you selected the wrong chest, close the menu, aim into empty air, hold {Sneak} and press {Use} with the Clipboard to clear the selection. Select the right chest and choose Assign Clipboard Storage again. If you cannot open the chest to load it, put the Clipboard away first.”


**Optional flavour line:** “Show me the chest where I should collect the parcel.”

**Task:** In Supplies mode, select A and apply to the courier.

**Check:** committed source, permission and reachable access.

**Provides:** source-container loan if necessary and pickup label; hold parcel until setup is valid.

steps.title: 3 Choose a different destination

cards.text: Open {Inventory} and right-click the Clipboard slot until a storage mode appears. Close the inventory and hold your Clipboard. Hold {ControlModifier} and scroll until it says Assign Output Storage.
Point at the output chest and press {Use}. That selects the chest; it has not assigned it yet.
Now point at me, your Courier, and press {Use} without sneaking. Click Assign Clipboard Storage in the menu. Show me that last step.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Identify this lesson’s output chest and named tutor. Show selection first, then acknowledge only the stored Output link for this worker. Opening the menu is an intermediate checkpoint.
sequences.recovery: If you selected the wrong chest, close the menu, aim into empty air, hold {Sneak} and press {Use} with the Clipboard to clear the selection. Select the right chest and choose Assign Clipboard Storage again. If you cannot open the chest to load it, put the Clipboard away first.

steps.design_objective: Select B in Output mode and apply.
steps.design_check: different container identity, access, filter compatibility and capacity.
steps.design_provisions: destination-container loan and delivery preview. A equals B is not a delivery.

2. “Point at the output chest and press {Use}. That selects the chest; it has not assigned it yet.”

steps.title: 4 Lay out the walk

cards.text: Open {Inventory}, right-click the Clipboard slot until Route Mode appears, then close the inventory.
Point at walkable ground near the pickup chest and press {Use}; then mark successive reachable ground blocks leading to the delivery chest. Stop there: leave this route open.
Point at me and press {Use} without sneaking to apply the route. Show me the route assignment notice.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Show ordered draft node markers, then the actual assigned route and walkability result. Guard’s tutorial authority stops after one full circuit despite a looping route; Courier’s endpoints must reach their respective containers.
sequences.recovery: If a node is wrong, hold {Sneak} and press {Use} on that node to remove it. To redraw, use the same input while aiming into air. A route that looks connected still needs a clear walkable path.

steps.design_objective: Add and apply Route nodes from near A to near B; use a simple non-looping route.
steps.design_check: stored usable route, path reachability and actual storage interaction positions tethered to serviced route nodes under courier rules.
steps.design_provisions: highlighted invalid segments and route controls help.
steps.design_notes:
4 Lay out the walk

**Teach and demonstrate (spoken in order):**
1. “Open {Inventory}, right-click the Clipboard slot until Route Mode appears, then close the inventory.”
2. “Point at walkable ground near the pickup chest and press {Use}; then mark successive reachable ground blocks leading to the delivery chest. Stop there: leave this route open.”
3. “Point at me and press {Use} without sneaking to apply the route. Show me the route assignment notice.”

**Show / confirm:** Show ordered draft node markers, then the actual assigned route and walkability result. Guard’s tutorial authority stops after one full circuit despite a looping route; Courier’s endpoints must reach their respective containers.

**If it goes wrong:** “If a node is wrong, hold {Sneak} and press {Use} on that node to remove it. To redraw, use the same input while aiming into air. A route that looks connected still needs a clear walkable path.”


**Optional flavour line:** “Lay out a clear walk between the chests. I need to reach both ends.”

**Task:** Add and apply Route nodes from near A to near B; use a simple non-looping route.

**Check:** stored usable route, path reachability and actual storage interaction positions tethered to serviced route nodes under courier rules.

**Provides:** highlighted invalid segments and route controls help.

steps.title: 5 Dispatch the parcel

cards.text: Put the Clipboard away. With an empty hand, press {Use} on me, then choose Job and Work Settings.
Choose Ask for Work Report first. If work is paused, click Start/Pause Work once. Leave it alone if work is already enabled, then close the conversation so I can work.
Show me those settings. We will begin once they are right.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Confirm work-enabled authority for this finite trial and show the real next worker action. Starting work is not evidence that the harvest, craft or delivery succeeded.
sequences.recovery: If you opened the Clipboard storage menu, close it and put the Clipboard away before talking to me again. If Job is unavailable, the lesson must restore your trial assignment; do not buy a paid hire to get past the tutorial.

steps.design_check: release four logs once into A; actual pickup becomes attributed courier cargo.
steps.design_provisions: four logs and picked-up/carried/delivered/remaining counters. Scope free work to these four allocated items, not everything in Supplies.
steps.design_notes:
5 Dispatch the parcel

**Teach and demonstrate (spoken in order):**
1. “Put the Clipboard away. With an empty hand, press {Use} on me, then choose Job and Work Settings.”
2. “Choose Ask for Work Report first. If work is paused, click Start/Pause Work once. Leave it alone if work is already enabled, then close the conversation so I can work.”
3. “Show me those settings. We will begin once they are right.”

**Show / confirm:** Confirm work-enabled authority for this finite trial and show the real next worker action. Starting work is not evidence that the harvest, craft or delivery succeeded.

**If it goes wrong:** “If you opened the Clipboard storage menu, close it and put the Clipboard away before talking to me again. If Job is unavailable, the lesson must restore your trial assignment; do not buy a paid hire to get past the tutorial.”


**Optional flavour line:** “The route is ready. Put out the four logs and I'll take them across.”

**Task:** Enable work.

**Check:** release four logs once into A; actual pickup becomes attributed courier cargo.

**Provides:** four logs and picked-up/carried/delivered/remaining counters. Scope free work to these four allocated items, not everything in Supplies.

steps.title: 6 Receive the full delivery

cards.text: Put the Clipboard away. With an empty hand, press {Use} on the delivery chest B to open it and look at what arrived.
Close the chest, then press {Use} on me, your Courier, with an empty hand. Return to our lesson conversation.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Show the attributable delivered goods and actual remaining amount. Reopening a chest or saying “done” never substitutes for the delivery receipt.
sequences.recovery: If it is empty, leave room in the output chest and ask me for a Work Report under Job → Work Settings. Follow the missing supplies, blocked path or full-output hint; moving your own matching items into it will not complete my work.

steps.design_objective: Inspect B and speak to the courier.
steps.design_check: all four allocated items passed through courier cargo into B; support capacity-limited multiple trips and full-output pauses. Player-moving unrelated logs does not count.
steps.design_notes:
6 Receive the full delivery

**Teach and demonstrate (spoken in order):**
1. “Put the Clipboard away. With an empty hand, press {Use} on the delivery chest B to open it and look at what arrived.”
2. “Close the chest, then press {Use} on me, your Courier, with an empty hand. Return to our lesson conversation.”

**Show / confirm:** Show the attributable delivered goods and actual remaining amount. Reopening a chest or saying “done” never substitutes for the delivery receipt.

**If it goes wrong:** “If it is empty, leave room in the output chest and ask me for a Work Report under Job → Work Settings. Follow the missing supplies, blocked path or full-output hint; moving your own matching items into it will not complete my work.”


**Optional flavour line:** “All four delivered. Would you like me to keep this route running?”

**Task:** Inspect B and speak to the courier.

**Check:** all four allocated items passed through courier cargo into B; support capacity-limited multiple trips and full-output pauses. Player-moving unrelated logs does not count.

**Provides/reward:** the delivered logs and reusable route. “All four delivered. Shall I keep this route running? Here's the usual hiring price.” Apply shared ending.

**A Continue working:** “Show me your normal price.” Present the current role, duration, currency and total. Start ordinary paid work only after the player accepts a still-valid quote.

**B Stop here:** “Thanks. Stop working.” End this tutorial assignment safely, reconcile its output and identifiable loans, and keep the lesson completed. Dismissal leaves work paused.


**New hooks:** committed source/destination/route; storage-tether readiness; pickup claim, cargo identity and successful insertion. Persist allocation and delivery ledger through reload/route edits; never reissue goods because the destination is full.
